## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Use the same revision identifier in running status and history so operators can match a running deployment to its history entry.

## Changes

The pull request adds a running deployment status line that displays an abbreviated revision and the attempt number.

## Important

- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Match the revision identifier used in history — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, running status displays `0123456` while history displays `0123456789ab`. The docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but status uses `revision[:7]` and history uses `revision[:12]`. — Operators cannot distinguish revisions in running status when the first seven characters match and the next five differ. — Fix: Match history’s 12-character abbreviation and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt`.
